individual_dispositions.complete_paragraph: In the frame this field runs on, the return has a face: the film recognized as film while the accounting stays precise — the light never confused with what it shows, and never absent from it. The exactness is retained at every joint, not surrendered at the close: the ratios still compute with their hypotheses held, the constituted measure still measures within published limits, the registration is still camera-work, exact and inspectable, and the loop is still audited as film while it runs. A measure answers to its declared frame, a world-model to the situation it represents, and an institution to its sources, participants and deciding authority. These relations remain inspectable through the same motion, and each distinction retains the warrant of the operation which earned it. In [operational parity](A33-prime-Parity.md), a proposed technical capacity has a named discriminating consequence; an executed claim must identify what actually changed. A philosophical derivation can be valid before a product implements it; a proposed configuration can be discriminating before its trial is complete. Their return becomes more exact when validity, construction, execution and successful inheritance remain distinguishable.

individual_dispositions.complete_paragraph: In a completed research inquiry, the cited result becomes inspectable; an objection returns to its source or framing; the office holding that condition judges the correction; the next inquiry inherits changed evidence or examined terms. A comparing agent can be the local functional knower, with retained sources, memory, rules and tools as means and the discriminated result as known. The complete apparatus is means within the person’s containing inquiry; further inspection makes its local judgment known through another act. The person’s first-person condition of that examination remains unobjectifiable. Source authority, governing purpose and the fitting comparison rule can remain adequate throughout; the later inquiry inherits their reasoned retention alongside the corrected evidence. Recognition concerns how those determining relations became present, rather than a compulsory sequence of ever deeper revisions. The crossover's "quantitative crossover triggers a qualitative transformation in what agency, identity, and society mean" (p. 53) stays under the [modal rider](../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042) — that world "may never arrive," and "may also be here already." On that modality the essay's reading is exact about the form: the second advent is not a demographic event that completes on a date; it is an achieved determination returning through its counting, source and judging relation while preserving the exact local offices it acquired. Through [accounting for an omitted contribution](A10-prime-Uncounted-Enters-the-Account.md), a previously excluded term gains an explicit office. Through [historical and crossed-zero integral return](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), the acquired sign passes through abstraction, regained relation and recognition. A demographic ratio gives that return a contemporary occasion, without identifying an omitted contribution with the unobjectifiable condition of appearing.
